payload.body: Changing NAHEL_ACTOR for a drive silently mis-attributes everything journaled afterwards, and the journal is append-only so it cannot be corrected in place. During the Decision Digest review a Cursor probe wrote events 25h56myf and r07fem2d as human:review-probe; they were not human acts and had to be excluded from the round's counts by a later correcting note, with the finding re-journaled under a correct agent actor. The correction is the only remedy: journal a note naming the mis-attributed event ids. Agents must set NAHEL_ACTOR=agent:<id> before the first CLI call of a session — an unset actor falls back to the config default (human:maintainer in this store), which manufactures fake human provenance.
